name: Terezi Pyrope
source:
Terezi Pyrope, also known by her Trollian handle, gallowsCalibrator, is one of the trolls.

She can be civil, flirty and derisive in her interactions. Her drive for justice results in some cruel actions, the majority of which she has been shown to be deeply affected by and regret later on. She is almost always grinning and often appears as though she is cackling madly. She has a keen interest in law and justice, having studied Alternian law thoroughly, and holds a particular fascination for orchestrating the demise of the wicked. She also has more lighthearted interests, like dragons and collecting plushies and scales to put on her walls. Though she is blind, Terezi can "smell" and "taste" colors.

Her associated zodiac sign is Libra. She is of teal blood caste.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Terezi_Pyrope]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
